description: Compute the Codebase Agent Health (CAH) score for a repository.

commands.name: agentrepocoach
commands.description: Score a repository for AI-agent readiness.

flags.name: --repo
flags.description: Path to the repository to score.

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Write full JSON result to this path.

flags.name: --prometheus
flags.description: Write Prometheus exposition metrics to this path.

flags.name: --comment
flags.description: Write a GitHub PR-comment markdown file to this path.

flags.name: --output
flags.description: Output path for --format. Required when --format is set.

flags.name: --quiet
flags.description: Print only the numeric total score.
